name: boswell-wp
description: The Boswell Sisters tribute archive — WordPress block theme + local dev environment.

scripts.build:blocks: for d in theme/bozzies/blocks/*/; do name=$(basename $d); wp-scripts build --webpack-src-dir=$d/src --output-path=$d/build; done
scripts.start:blocks: for d in theme/bozzies/blocks/*/; do name=$(basename $d); wp-scripts start --webpack-src-dir=$d/src --output-path=$d/build; done
